name: reverse-engineering
description: Investigate shipped apps, binaries, and real website flows with REA evidence and available Computer Use tools.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate apps, binaries, and real website flows.
interface.longDescription: Use REA CLI or MCP for evidence-backed artifact analysis and available Computer Use tools for actual website interactions. Includes feature tracing, version comparison, reconstruction verification, and source attribution. Analysis runtimes are supplied separately.
defaultPrompt: Explain how the selected app feature works using artifact and runtime evidence.
Use the selected website to investigate its search and detail flow, recording actions, observed states, and unknowns.
